transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm here because the regular clinic doctor got on me about my eating. I don't really see the big deal, honestly. Most days I just... keep it simple. Just coffee in the morning, maybe a few bites of something between painting jobs... and a small dinner if I'm not too busy with my class paperwork. I'm just busy, I guess. That's pretty much it.
Have you lost a lot of weight recently, or do you feel like you weigh less than you should?

Um... I don't know about a lot. My work pants hang pretty loose now, I guess. And... people on the job sites keep saying I look too thin. But I don't really see it like that. I'm just on my ladders and on my feet all day painting. I figure I've just... leaned out from the work, really.
Can you tell me how much weight you think you’ve lost, and whether you’ve noticed any changes in your appetite or the amount of food you eat?

Um... I don't really know about the weight. I don't keep a scale around or anything, so... I couldn't give you a number. Just the clothes thing I mentioned. 

As for my appetite... I don't know. It feels normal to me. I just eat what I need to get through the day. I haven't really noticed any big changes.
Would you say that you're eating less than usual, or that you don't feel like eating most days?
Um... I guess I eat less than I used to. But... I don't really think about it. I just don't feel that hungry most days.
Would you say that food doesn’t interest you most days, or that you actively avoid eating even when you know you should?

Um... I don't know about avoiding it. I guess I'm mostly just here because the clinic doctor got on me about my eating. But... I just keep it simple most days. 

I'll have coffee in the morning... maybe a few bites of something between jobs. And then just a small dinner, if I'm not too busy with my class paperwork. I just... I don't really focus on it much.
Do you find that you have to force yourself to eat, even when you know you should eat more?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I don't feel like I have to force it. I just eat what I'm used to. I don't really sit around thinking I should be eating more than that.
Would you say that food or eating has become something you really don’t care about, or has it stayed about the same for you?
Um... I guess it's mostly stayed about the same. I just... I don't really pay that much attention to it either way.
Have you noticed any changes in how food smells or tastes to you lately, or does food still appeal to you the way it used to?
Um... no. I haven't really noticed anything like that. It all just... tastes the same as it always does, I guess.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or have less energy than usual most days?
Um... no, not really. I feel about the same. I haven't really noticed being more tired than usual.
Have you noticed that you’re less interested in things you used to enjoy, or do you still get the same pleasure out of your usual activities?
Um... I think it's about the same. I still do my normal stuff, I guess. I haven't really noticed a difference.
Can you estimate how much weight you think you’ve lost, even if it’s just a guess based on how your clothes fit or what others have said?

Um... I don't know an exact number. I guess... my work pants do hang pretty loose now. And, um, some of the guys on the job sites have made comments about me looking too thin. But... I don't know, I just see it as leaning out. I'm on my feet all day painting, so... it makes sense.
Can you recall if you’ve lost more than 5% of your body weight in the past 6 months without trying?
Um... I really couldn't tell you a percentage. I don't weigh myself like that. I just... I'm just working, so... I don't know. I haven't really kept track of it.
Without needing an exact number, would you say that you’ve lost a noticeable amount of weight over the last six months—like if someone pointed out you looked significantly thinner than before?
Um... I mean, like I said, some of the guys at work brought it up. But... I don't really know if it's a lot. I just... I haven't really been paying attention to it like that.
Would you say that you’ve lost more than just a little weight over the last six months—like if someone would notice you look significantly thinner than before?
Um... I don't really know what else to tell you. Like I just said, the guys at work noticed, so... maybe? But I don't know what counts as significant. I'm really not focused on it like that.
Would you say that your weight loss over the past six months has been more than just slight — like, if someone who hadn’t seen you in a while would notice you look definitely thinner?

Um... I feel like you're just asking me the exact same thing again. I really don't have a different answer for you. I don't see a lot of people outside of work, so... I don't know what someone who hasn't seen me in a while would think. I just put my work clothes on and go paint. I'm really not paying attention to it.
Would you say that you’ve lost more than 5% of your body weight in the past 6 months without trying to?
I... I don't know percentages. Like I said, I haven't been trying to lose weight, and I don't weigh myself. I just... I don't have a number for you.
Without needing an exact number, would you say that your weight loss over the past six months has been more than 5% — like a noticeable change that others might pick up on?

I... I really don't know how else to answer this. Like I already said, the guys at work noticed. I don't know anything about five percent or... whatever. I just don't have anything else to tell you about it.

Can you confirm if you’ve unintentionally lost more than 5% of your body weight in the past 6 months—like if your weight loss is over 10 pounds if you weigh around 200 pounds, or proportionally similar for your weight?
I... I don't know why we keep going in circles with this. I don't know my weight. I don't know pounds or percentages. I just... I don't have that information.
Have you had any medical problems or symptoms lately, like feeling sick, having pain, or changes in your digestion?
I haven't really noticed anything like that. I feel fine.
